taskTitle: Where ten HTTP header fields are defined

checks.detail: 3 proposers ran in parallel, one per lens
4 phases had the tools designed for them

finalText:
I picked proposal 2. All three proposals give the same RFC and section for every field, so the quotes decided it.

**Results**
- **Age:** RFC 9111, section 5.1 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9111.html)
- **Cache-Control:** RFC 9111, section 5.2 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9111.html)
- **Expires:** RFC 9111, section 5.3 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9111.html)
- **Last-Modified:** RFC 9110, section 8.8.2 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html)
- **ETag:** RFC 9110, section 8.8.3 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html)
- **Location:** RFC 9110, section 10.2.2 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html)
- **Retry-After:** RFC 9110, section 10.2.3 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html)
- **Vary:** RFC 9110, section 12.5.5 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html)
- **Strict-Transport-Security:** RFC 6797, section 6.1 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6797.html)
- **Link:** RFC 8288, section 3 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8288.html)

**Why the older RFCs don't count**
- RFC 9110's header lists what it obsoletes: "2818, 7230, 7231, 7232, 7233, 7235, 7538, 7615, 7694" (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html).
- RFC 9111 says "This document obsoletes RFC 7234." (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9111.html).
- RFC 8288 says "Obsoletes: 5988" (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8288.html).

**One check is still missing:** no proposal could confirm from a status page that RFC 9110, 9111, 6797 or 8288 hasn't itself been replaced since. The RFC Editor status pages returned 404, and no opened page or search result pointed to a replacement.

**About the quotes:** each quote is the opening sentence of its section. The pages wrap lines and put two spaces after full stops, and these quotes are joined onto one line with single spaces. If the checker compares spacing exactly, that's the one thing that could cause a mismatch.
